Message.Name: Heartbeat Message
Message.Description: Heartbeat / line integrity message transmitted every 5 seconds. Contains only the standard message header (MessageType "0").

Message.Name: Index Value Message
Message.Description: Index Value message containing values associated with a calculated index. May include Index Value, Bid, and Ask MDEntries.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Index Symbol / iNAV Symbol / Cryptocurrency. Maximum 12 characters.

Field.Name: NoMDEntries
Field.Description: Number of MDEntries in this message. Will not exceed 255.

Field.Name: MDEntries
Field.Description: Repeating MDEntries group; repeats NoMDEntries times. Each entry is {MDEntryType, MDEntryPx}.

Message.Name: Contributor Value Message
Message.Description: Contributor Value message containing values associated with a given symbol or index, transmitted when received by Cboe.

Field.Name: TransactTime
Field.Description: Time that data was calculated or produced from client. Applies only to this message within the packet.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Index Symbol / iNAV Symbol / Cryptocurrency. Maximum 12 characters.

Field.Name: NoMDEntries
Field.Description: Number of MDEntries in this message. Will not exceed 255.

Field.Name: MDEntries
Field.Description: Repeating MDEntries group; repeats NoMDEntries times. Each entry is {MDEntryType, MDEntryPx}.

Message.Name: Index Summary Message
Message.Description: Index Summary message containing values associated with start or end of day. Includes an effective business date for reference.

Field.Name: TransactTime
Field.Description: Time that data was calculated or produced from client. Applies only to this message within the packet.

Field.Name: EffectiveBusinessDate
Field.Description: Effective business date in YYYYMMDD format.

Field.Name: SummaryType
Field.Description: Type of summary message.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Index Symbol / iNAV Symbol / Cryptocurrency. Maximum 12 characters.

Field.Name: NoMDEntries
Field.Description: Number of MDEntries in this message. Will not exceed 255.

Field.Name: MDEntries
Field.Description: Repeating MDEntries group; repeats NoMDEntries times. Each entry is {MDEntryType, MDEntryPx}.

Message.Name: Index Value With Status Message
Message.Description: Index Value With Status message contains the values associated with a calculated index along with a status describing whether the value is indicative or not. Valid entry types include close and settlement markers.

Field.Name: IndexStatus
Field.Description: Status of the index value. N = Normal, I = Indicative.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Index Symbol / iNAVSymbol. Maximum 12 characters.

Field.Name: NoMDEntries
Field.Description: Number of MDEntries in this message. Will not exceed 255.

Field.Name: MDEntries
Field.Description: Repeating MDEntries group; repeats NoMDEntries times. Each entry is {MDEntryType, MDEntryPx}.

Message.Name: Index Definition Message
Message.Description: Index Definition message published for every index within each cycle. Contains index information including current status, channel name, current trading date, data source, and description. Published on the Cboe Global Indices Definition Feed (CGIDF).

Field.Name: Current Record Number
Field.Description: Clients should begin capturing data beginning at 1.

Field.Name: Total Number of Records
Field.Description: Total number of updates within loop.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: External index symbol.

Field.Name: Description Length
Field.Description: Length in bytes of the Description that follows.

Field.Name: Description
Field.Description: Description of the index. Variable length.

Field.Name: Date
Field.Description: Current trading date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

Field.Name: Status
Field.Description: Status of index. 1 = Active (loaded and a business day), 2 = Inactive (loaded and not a business day), 3 = Deleted (no longer distributed; removed from the feed after 30 days).

Field.Name: Agent Classification
Field.Description: Originating source of the index. blank = Not Specified, CO = Cboe, CC = Cboe Custom, MS = Morningstar, TP = Third-party, MC = Morningstar Customer.

Field.Name: NoChannels
Field.Description: Number of Channels in this message.

Field.Name: Channels
Field.Description: Repeating Channels group; repeats NoChannels times. Each entry is {Channel Length, Channel}.

Field.Name: Symbol Length
Field.Description: Byte Length

Field.Name: Symbol Chars
Field.Description: Symbol Chars

Field.Name: Exponent
Field.Description: Exponent

Field.Name: Mantissa
Field.Description: Mantissa

Field.Name: Byte Length
Field.Description: Byte Length

Field.Name: Date Chars
Field.Description: Date Chars

Field.Name: Byte Length
Field.Description: Byte Length

Field.Name: EffectiveBusinessDate Chars
Field.Description: EffectiveBusinessDate Chars

Group.Name: MDEntries
Group.Description: One entry in a repeating MDEntries group. Repeats NoMDEntries times within the containing message.

Field.Name: MDEntryType
Field.Description: Market Data Entry Type. 0 = Bid, 1 = Ask, 3 = Index Value, 5 = Close Value, 6 = Settlement / EDSP Price.

Field.Name: MDEntryPx
Field.Description: Value associated with MDEntryType. Encoded as 1 byte signed exponent followed by 4 byte signed mantissa.

Group.Name: Channels
Group.Description: One entry in a repeating Channels group. Repeats NoChannels times within the containing message.

Field.Name: Channel Length
Field.Description: Length in bytes of the Channel that follows.

Field.Name: Channel
Field.Description: Channel name. MAIN = Cboe Global Indices Feed Main, CGI = Strategy/Benchmark/Custom Indices, MSCI = MSCI, INAV = Intraday Net Asset Values, FTSE = FTSE Russell, MSTAR = Morningstar, CCCY = Crypto Currency.

Value.Name: Market Data Incremental Refresh
Value.Description: Shared by Contributor Value, Index Summary, Index Value, and Index Value With Status messages. Body determined by Template ID.

Value.Name: Active
Value.Description: Active - loaded and a business day

Value.Name: Inactive
Value.Description: Inactive - loaded and not a business day

Value.Name: Deleted
Value.Description: Deleted - no longer distributed; removed from the feed after 30 days
